exposure: early discharge (enabled by enhanced family-centered care (FCC))
outcome: proportion of breastmilk of daily feeding volume
cohort: The study included 184 preterm infants from six consecutive cohorts (one baseline and five intervention cohorts) at a single institution.
finding: Early discharge of preterm infants, even with increased home nasogastric tube feeding, did not reduce breastmilk supply or exclusive breastfeeding rates up to 3 months postmenstrual age.
